description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (ContentRowAdapter) for rendering a list of content rows in an Android application. Each content row contains a title and a horizontal list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure the row titles are visible when focus moves to a card within the row.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: A ListAdapter for displaying a list of ContentRow objects, each with a title and nested horizontal RecyclerView of content cards.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class that manages references to the row title TextView and inner RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_content_row layout and creates a new RowVH.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow item to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: RowVH.bind
methods.description: Configures the ViewHolder with data from a ContentRow, setting up nested RecyclerView and handling focus behavior for visibility.
